l-e-e1-b07-02.title: Yaya ake karanta wasali idan aka ƙara e a ƙarshe?
l-e-e1-b07-02.topic: E na ƙarshe da sautukan wasali
l-e-e1-b07-02.goal: Nemo ka faɗi ƙa’idar karanta wasali a kalmomin da ke da e a ƙarshe daga misalai da dama, sannan ka gwada ƙa’idar da sabon misali.
l-e-e1-b07-02.material: Idan aka ƙara e, sautin yana canzawa. cap (gajeren sautin a) -> cape (dogon sautin a), kit (gajeren sautin i) -> kite (dogon sautin i), hop (gajeren sautin o) -> hope (dogon sautin o). Nemo ƙa’idar, sannan ka karanta pine.
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s1.prompt: Idan ƙa’idar ta tabbata, yaya za ka karanta i a cikin pine, wato pin da aka ƙara masa e?
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s1.o.a: Karanta shi kamar sunan harafin i, da dogon sautin “eye”.
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s1.o.b: Karanta shi a gajere kamar pin, da gajeren sautin “ih”.
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s1.r.b: Wannan shi ne gajeren sautin da yake kafin a ƙara e. Bai bi ƙa’idar ba.
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s1.o.c: Karanta shi a dogon sautin e, “ee”.
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s1.r.c: An karanta shi da sautin sunan harafin e da aka ƙara. Wannan ya bambanta da ƙa’idar.
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s1.o.d: I ɗin ba ya da sauti.
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s1.r.d: Sautin i ne yake canzawa, ba na e ba.
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s1.explain: Idan aka ƙara e, wasalin tsakiya yana ɗaukar sautin sunan harafinsa. Cape yana da sautin “ay”, kite yana da “eye”, hope kuma yana da “oh”.
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s2.model.0: A cikin cape, kite da hope, wasalin tsakiya yana ɗaukar sautin sunan harafinsa bayan an ƙara e; saboda haka i a pine ma ana karanta shi da sautin “eye”.
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s2.model.1: A duk kalmomin ukun, idan aka ƙara e a ƙarshe, wasali yana tsawaita kamar sunan harafinsa; saboda haka idan pin ya koma pine, i yana da sautin “eye”.

l-e-e1-b07-09.title: Ƙa’idar kalmomin adadi masu ƙarewa da “ty”
l-e-e1-b07-09.topic: Kalmar adadin da ke zuwa bayan 20, 30, 40, 50
l-e-e1-b07-09.goal: Dubi misalai da dama na yadda kalmomin adadi da ke ƙaruwa da 10 suke ƙarewa, gano ƙa’idar ka bayyana ta, sannan ka gwada da sabon misali.
l-e-e1-b07-09.material: Daga 20 zuwa sama, adadin yana ƙaruwa da 10. 20 → twenty, 30 → thirty, 40 → forty, 50 → fifty. Nemo ƙa’idar, sannan ka faɗi adadi na gaba da Turanci.
l-e-e1-b07-09.s.s1.r.c: “Six” da “ten” ne aka haɗa. Babu irin wannan kalma.

l-e-e1-b07-09.s.s2.model.0: 20, 30, 40 da 50 duk suna ƙarewa da “ty”, don haka 60 ma “sixty” ne, wato “six” da “ty”.
l-e-e1-b07-09.s.s2.model.1: “Sixteen” na nufin 16, “sixth” kuma na nufin na shida a jere, don haka ba su dace ba. Bisa ƙa’idar, “sixty” mai ƙarewa da “ty” ce daidai.

l-e-e1-b07-08.title: Akwai kusan tuffa nawa a cikin akwatin?
l-e-e1-b07-08.goal: Yi kiyasin yawan tuffa a cikin akwati, zaɓi adadi ko zangon da ya dace, sannan ka bayyana dalilinka.
l-e-e1-b07-08.material: Ana jera tuffa 5 a kowane layi a cikin akwati. An cika layuka 4, amma layin ƙarshe yana da gurbi 1 babu tuffa. Mu yi kiyasi da kalmomin adadin Turanci.

l-e-e1-b07-08.s.s1.r.a: Wannan adadin layi ɗaya ne kawai. Akwai layuka 4.
l-e-e1-b07-08.s.s1.r.b: Wannan adadin layuka biyu ne kawai. Akwai layuka 4.
l-e-e1-b07-08.s.s1.r.d: Ya yi yawa. Tuffa 5 a kowane layi na layuka 4 kusan 20 ne.
l-e-e1-b07-08.s.s1.explain: Tuffa 5 a kowane ɗaya daga layuka 4 su ne 20; da gurbi 1 babu komai, sun zama 19. A matsayin kiyasi, kusan ashirin ne.
l-e-e1-b07-08.s.s2.model.0: Tuffa 5 a kowane ɗaya daga layuka 4 su ne 20, kuma gurbi 1 ne kawai babu komai, don haka kusan 20 ne. “about twenty” ne ya fi dacewa.
l-e-e1-b07-08.s.s2.model.1: Kowane layi na da 5, akwai layuka 4, saboda haka jimillar tana kusa da 20. Shi ya sa “about twenty” ya fi “about ten” ko “about five” dacewa.

l-e-e1-b07-04.material: Sam ya ji malami ya ce “Sit down.” sai ya yi tunani: 1) Sit da Stand duka suna farawa da S. 2) Saboda haka kalmomin biyu ma’ana ɗaya suke da ita. 3) Don haka Sam ya miƙe tsaye.

l-e-e1-b07-04.s.s1.r.d: “Sit down.” na nufin zama, saboda haka miƙewa tsaye ba daidai ba ne.
l-e-e1-b07-04.s.s1.explain: Ko da harafin farko iri ɗaya ne, ma’anoni sun bambanta. Sit na nufin zama, Stand kuma na nufin tsayawa.
